Novatek AI SDK Notes

Version
 * vendor_ai_version: 02.19.2111250
 * kflow_ai_version: 02.18.2111250
 * kdrv_ai_version: 01.14.2105250
Version from master
 * vendor_ai_version: 02.19.2111250
 * kflow_ai_version: 02.18.2111250
 * kdrv_ai_version: 01.14.2105250
NvtAITool version
 * tool version: 1.05.03
Feature/modification
 * User can use vendor_ais_get_net_id / vendor_ais_release_net_id api to get/release valid net_id
Usage influence
 * Modifications that influence usage
   NA
 * Usage note
   1. User can get valid id by calling vendor_ais_get_net_id before calling vendor_ais_net_gen_init.
   2. If user want to uninit the network and release the net id, user can call vendor_ais_release_net_id after calling vendor_ais_net_gen_uninit.
   3. User can refer to AI_USE_NET_ID_FROM_KFLOW define and check how to use those api.
 * Sample code: alg_net_app_user_sample.c

Feature/modification
 * User can use dynamic batch function
Usage influence

 * Usage note
   User can refer AI_TEST_DYNAMIC_BATCH define and check usage.
 * Sample code: alg_net_app_user_sample_multi_in.c

NvtAITool version
 * tool version: 1.03.01
Feature/modification
 * User can select CPU running id in AI thread
Usage influence
 * Modifications that influence usage
   1. If user wants to set CPU affinity, user can check AI_CPU_AFFINITY_TEST define in alg_net_app_user_sample.c.
   2. Makefile for sample code should add some link library. User can check difference of makefile in alg_net_app_user_sample.
 * Usage note
   User can refer AI_CPU_AFFINITY_TEST define and check usage.
 * Sample code: alg_net_app_user_sample.c

Feature/modification

Usage influence

Version
 * vendor_ai_version: 02.10.2012080
 * kdrv_ai_version: 01.12.2012080
Version from master
 * vendor_ai_version: 02.10.2012080
 * kdrv_ai_version: 01.12.2012080
NvtAITool version
 * tool version: 1.03.01
Feature/modification
 * Add kdrv/kflow version query API
Usage influence
 * Modifications that influence usage
   1. If user wants to query kdrv version, user can use vendor_ai_get_kdrv_version to achieve the goal.
   2. If user wants to query kflow version, user can use vendor_ai_get_kflow_version to achieve the goal.
 * Usage note
   User can refer alg_net_app_user_sample.c line 882 and check usage.
 * Sample code: alg_net_app_user_sample.c

Version
 * vendor_ai_version: 02.09.2012030
 * kdrv_ai_version: 01.11.2011160
Version from master
 * vendor_ai_version: 02.09.2012030
 * kdrv_ai_version: 01.11.2011160
Feature/modification
 * Support float to fix api with querying input frac bit
Usage influence
 * Modifications that influence usage
   1. If user wants to do float to fix on input data, user can use vendor_ais_float_to_fix to achieve the goal.
   2. If user wants to get input layer frac bit, user can use vendor_ais_get_input_layer_mem to query input layer info.
 * Usage note
   User can refer alg_net_app_user_sample.c and check for TEST_FLOAT_TO_FIX for api usage.
 * Sample code: alg_net_app_user_sample.c
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Usage influence

Version
 * vendor_ai_version: 02.07.2011061
 * kdrv_ai_version: 01.10.2011060
Version from master
 * vendor_ai_version: 02.07.2011061
 * kdrv_ai_version: 01.10.2011060
Feature/modification
 * Add vendor_ais_get_layer_mem_v2/vendor_ais_net_input_init_v2 api
 * Support permute stripe for app mode
Usage influence
 * Modifications that influence usage
   1. If user wants to assign different channel information in one image, user can use vendor_ais_net_input_init_v2.
   2. If user wants to get layer memory directly, user can use vendor_ais_get_layer_mem_v2 instead of vendor_ais_get_layer_mem.
   3. For supporting permute stripe, please note that the app model less than 4.1 is not compatible in this sdk.
 * Usage note
   User can refer alg_net_app_user_sample.c for api usage.
 * Sample code: alg_net_app_user_sample.c

Version
 * vendor_ai_version: 02.01.2010072
 * kdrv_ai_version: 01.09.2010071
Version from master
 * vendor_ai_version: 02.01.2010072
 * kdrv_ai_version: 01.09.2010071
Feature/modification
 * add prototxt info in customer layer
 * default enable MODIFY_ENG_ONLINE
Usage influence
 * Modifications that influence usage
   1. for customer layer, prototxt parameter is parsed for user's usage.
   2. for default enable MODIFY_ENG_ONLINE, sample code use another define MODIFY_ENG_IN_SAMPLE to enable modify engine
 * Usage note
   1. for customer layer change, 
      user can refer net_cust_layer.c and get information through variable below:
      //CUSTNN_POOL_PROTO_PARM *p_proto_pool_parm = (CUSTNN_POOL_PROTO_PARM*)p_prototxt_parm;
	  //CUSTNN_SLICE_PROTO_PARM *p_proto_slice_parm = (CUSTNN_SLICE_PROTO_PARM*)p_prototxt_parm;
   2. for default enable MODIFY_ENG_ONLINE, 
      since sample code use another define, user can modify the define to enable function:
	  #define MODIFY_ENG_IN_SAMPLE 0 // set to 1 means use modify engine api
 * Sample code: alg_net_app_user_sample.c / net_cust_layer.c
